question: Will at least one film surpass US$1 billion in worldwide box office before May 1, 2026?
summary: Avatar: Fire and Ash crossed $1B worldwide by January 2026, confirming that the 1B barrier is already achievable within the May 1 window.
The objections identify plausible verification and macro-headwind risks, but they do not negate the reality of a 1B title already in play and a strong 2025–2026 pipeline.
Historical cadence of multiple 1B films in 2025–early 2026 supports a high base-rate for any film reaching $1B by May 1, 2026.
